title: HardwareTest program sidecar
description: Session, DUT, and Typst report policy beside a locked .TapPlan. Instrument requirements belong in .TapPackage Dependencies, not here.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor intellisense.

requiredFields.description: DUT/session fields this program requires. serial, partNumber, revision, and operator map to the require* flags; additional ids are stored for later operator surfaces.

reportKinds.description: Typst PDFs to generate after a run. status and certification are shipped; additional ids are stored for this workspace.

defaultReportKind.description: Kind Results opens on double-click. Must be listed in reportKinds.

selectionIncludesCleanup.description: When false, Run Selected excludes SafeShutdownStep.

includeSafeShutdown.description: When true, Cleanup includes Safe Shutdown even if no explicit instrument slots are checked.

cleanupInstrumentSlots.description: Explicit Safe Shutdown slots (inspector checkboxes). Union-only identity/measure slots are not listed when includeMeasureSlots is true.

includeMeasureSlots.description: When true, Safe Shutdown also unions identity and measure instrument slots from this program.

programKind.description: dut (default) is a unit program. stationHealth is a bench cal / health program. Additional ids are stored for this workspace.

requireStationHealth.description: When true on a DUT sidecar, evaluate the station-health gate before Run (Area 5).

stationHealthMaxAgeHours.description: DUT freshness window in hours when requireStationHealth is true.

stationHealthGate.description: DUT gate level when requireStationHealth is true. Default warn.
